text: Add modular hybrid code intelligence for semantic maps and improvement discovery
description: Provide code search and mapping that combines exact search, symbols/references, syntax chunks, semantic embeddings, dependency structure, git churn, tests/coverage, and aim history. Expose focused tools such as code_search, symbol_context, change_impact, and high-leverage improvement discovery without loading every capability into every loop.
reflection: Extended the modular code-intelligence capability with aim-history retrieval. The compact code_intelligence tool now has an optional aim-history mode that searches active and archived aim text, descriptions, free-text and structured reflections, and status notes; ranks exact/token matches; and surfaces realized Git commit references without loading another tool into every loop. Existing semantic index, heatmap/churn, symbol, and impact modes remain unchanged. Verification: focused code-intelligence behavior test passes with active and archived fixtures; agent-tools and loop-worker TypeScript checks pass; git diff check passes.

status.comment: Semantic/heuristic code intelligence, incremental indexing, modular capability packs, and aim-history retrieval are implemented. LSP/AST precision and coverage/failure signals remain optional future improvements.
